introduction: Explore the Bronze Citadel’s wall maze, keyed wings, bronze cube and prison while helping Zariel with two distinct item returns.
orientation: The citadel gate outside in Avernus leads to the entrance, and the gate at the entrance leads back when available. The two gates are objects rather than ordinary room exits.
Follow the wall maze and look for the Dungeon Master and Zariel’s secret cell. A source encounter does not reveal an unmet giver’s request.
Ask Zariel hello. The conversation introduces the Dungeon Master; it is a conversation lead, not another completed quest.
Bring the Dungeon Master’s seal to Zariel for her intricate black stone key. The key fits the eastern wing from the foyer; recovering, using and keeping a key are different steps of exploration.

The bronze cube lies in a room reached from Baalzephon’s chamber. Its declared command is stand cube, which can open the blocked upward route in the foyer. Opening a route and crossing it are separate.
Bel carries the still-beating heart. Its fire trap can interrupt the first pickup attempt; recover the heart before preparing the return. A supplied exact heart also fits.
Zariel’s heart return currently gives one suit of Nessus royal guard platemail and makes her depart. The old response promises two items and potions; that description needs a builder decision.
The two returns remain independent. A supplied exact heart is accepted without remembered dialogue, seal completion, personal kills, key use or cube operation.

Dagos, Baalzephon, the silver and chromatic dragons, human wall encounters, guards, Bel’s followers and the prison cells offer wider progression leads. Rescue, restoration and equipment operations need their own defined outcomes.

stories.title: Bring the Dungeon Master’s seal to Zariel
stories.summary: Return the exact seal for the intricate black stone key. The key helps with citadel access; using it is a separate part of the journey.

steps.text: Carry the seal of the Dungeon Master loose
steps.hint: The Dungeon Master carries this exact seal near Zariel’s secret cell. Carry it loose. A supplied exact seal also fits; equipped or nested stock does not prepare the offering.
Offer the seal to Zariel when she is present. This return earns the black stone key; later unlocking, the bronze cube and the heart return are separate.

stories.title: Bring Bel’s heart to Zariel
stories.summary: Return Bel’s exact heart for one armor reward and Zariel’s departure. Her transformation and the promised potions in the old response need builder review.

steps.text: Carry the still-beating heart of Bel loose
steps.hint: Bel carries this exact trapped heart in his private chamber. A first pickup attempt can trigger fire without recovering the heart. Carry the recovered or supplied exact heart loose for the offering.

Offer the exact heart to Zariel when she is present. The current reward is one suit of Nessus royal guard platemail, followed by her departure. A supplied heart fits without a remembered seal return, personal kill or cube operation.
